Only methods declared in sugar-testing/src, or inherited from a parent declared there, are listed. A type that extends a class outside that tree, such as \RuntimeException, does not show the methods of that class.

ProgramSimulator final class

Drives a Program (or bare Model) with scripted input, deterministically.

MethodSummary
static new(Model|Program $program): selfFactory — wrap a Program or a bare Model for testing.
static for(Model|Program $program): self
addMsgs(Msg ...$msgs): selfEnqueue messages for the run() cycle, mutating this handle.
withFakeCmdRunner(\Closure $runner): selfInstall a fake runner that decides the message injected for each Cmd.
withRealCmdRunner(bool $execute): selfOpt-out of cmd execution for deterministic capture-only mode.
captureCmds(): selfCapture-only arm in one call: every cmd emitted during the run lands in the result's cmds list but nothing executes — the direct spelling of withRealCmdRunner(false), side-effect-free by construction.
withCmdCapture(\Closure $onCmd): selfCapture without executing AND substitute each cmd's result, in one clone: the pair withFakeCmdRunner($onCmd) + withRealCmdRunner(false). The closure receives the cmd — and only the cmd; it must not invoke it, since nothing here executes — and returns the message to inject in place of whatever the real cmd would have produced.
withFrameCapture(bool $capture = true): selfControl per-frame retention in TestResult::$frames.
withWindowSize(int $cols, int $rows): selfArm the startup WindowSizeMsg (dispatched before init(), like Program).
withEnvironment(array $vars): selfArm the startup EnvMsg (dispatched before init(), like Program).
withColorProfile(ColorProfile $profile): selfArm the startup ColorProfileMsg (dispatched before init(), like Program) — the message candy-top's color veto keys off.
run(): TestResultDrain the message queue, running init/update/view in sequence.

command(): stringThe OSC command verb, e.g. File or Pop.

KittyImage final class

One decoded Kitty graphics transmission (a single image or placement).

MethodSummary
static fromTransmit(array $params, string $payload): self
action(): string
id(): ?int
number(): ?int
cols(): ?intDeclared width in character cells (c).
rows(): ?intDeclared height in character cells (r).
pixelWidth(): ?intDeclared pixel width (s).
pixelHeight(): ?intDeclared pixel height (v).
offsetX(): ?int
offsetY(): ?int
zIndex(): ?intThe z stacking index — deliberately NOT a compression flag.
format(): ?stringThe raw f transmission-format value, or null when the sender omitted it.
compressed(): boolWhether the payload was transmitted zlib-compressed (o=z) and already inflated here.
pngPassthrough(): boolWhether the f code declares the payload a complete PNG — f=100 (the upstream code) or f=12 (the synonym accepted alongside it), both listed in PNG_PASSTHROUGH_FORMATS. Orthogonal to compressed(): an f=100,o=z transmit is a PNG that arrived zlib-wrapped and was inflated here.
rawPayload(): stringThe reassembled, decoded payload bytes for this transmit — already zlib-inflated for an o=z image and empty for a data-less placement. Unlike png() this never throws on an empty payload.
hasPayload(): boolWhether this transmit carries image data at all (placements do not).
png(): stringThe image payload bytes for this transmit: a PNG for a PNG-format (f=100/f=12) transmit — arrived plain or o=z-inflated — raw pixel data for an f=24/f=32 transmit.
params(): array
pixelDimensions(): arrayDecode the PNG payload into a GD image and report its real pixel size.
toGdImage(): \GdImage

MethodSummary
static load(string $path): ?stringLoad a golden file's contents.
